transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1106 Cairngrove Lane?

Yeah, this is me at 1106 Cairngrove Lane, just hanging out with three people, no water in yet, and I’ve got two seats available if you’re sending anything—just don’t send a truck or boat, we’re good here.
Thanks for confirming your address and safety status. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
There are three people here total, and everyone’s able to be reached—no one’s stuck inside or can’t come to the phone.

Got it, everyone here can be reached. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one here can’t leave on their own, and no wheelchairs or oxygen here—just three of us, all good to go, no special needs or equipment.
Understood, no one here can’t leave on their own. Is there water inside the home right now?

No water inside at all, just us three folks hanging tight, and I’ve got a truck and boat ready to go if you need us—wait, no, actually, no truck or boat, just two seats available, but we’re good here.
You’re holding tight, and we’re aware of your setup. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
Nope, no truck or boat here, but I’ve got two seats in my car if anyone needs a ride out—just say the word, 1106 Cairngrove Lane.
Thanks for offering a ride—your info noted. Let me read that back: 3 people; no water inside yet; you can help with 2 free seats. Is that right?
Yeah, that’s right—three of us, no water in yet, and I’ve got two seats free, so we’re good to go if you’re coming by.

Got it, three people, no water in, two seats free. I've recorded that you may be able to help neighbors. A dispatcher may contact you. Only go out if it's safe for you, and never drive into water you can't see the bottom of. Goodbye.
